ed25519-donna_2015-03-16_gcc13_x64_ed255.license: public domain, as declared in the header of each source file (Andrew M.); the repository ships no licence file
ed25519-donna_2015-03-16_gcc13_x64_ed255.notes: The master HEAD of a repository with no releases, built as ed25519.c compiled straight into a shared object, once as upstream's default code for the target (32-bit on x86, __int128 on x64) and once with -DED25519_SSE2. Uses upstream's reference SHA-512 (ED25519_REFHASH), which Tor replaces with its own digest, so sha512_blocks and the ed25519_hash_* functions are not in a Tor build. ed25519_randombytes_unsafe is the only function not from upstream: a memset stub in scripts/corpus/exercisers, which resolves the symbol ED25519_CUSTOMRANDOM leaves open and must never run. 30 named functions of ten instructions or more in the generic x64 artefacts, 32 in the x86 ones and 33 in the SSE2 ones: the DONNA_INLINE force-inlining does not reduce this - without it the count is within two. Crypto++ 8.x ships a port of part of this code, so about 8 (x64) to 11 (x86) of these functions also match data/cryptopp under its C++ names; libsodium shares none. ED25519_SUFFIX is not set, so symbols are ed25519_publickey and not Tor's ed25519_publickey_donna.

ed25519-donna_2015-03-16_msvc143_x64_ed2.compiler: Microsoft (R) C/C++ Optimizing Compiler Version 19.44.35229 for x64
ed25519-donna_2015-03-16_msvc143_x64_ed2.license: public domain, as declared in the header of each source file (Andrew M.); the repository ships no licence file
ed25519-donna_2015-03-16_msvc143_x64_ed2.notes: The same commit and defines as the MinGW and Linux recipes, built with cl into a DLL, once as upstream's default code for the target and once with -DED25519_SSE2. cl builds upstream's own MSVC branch: __int128 is replaced by _umul128 so x64 takes the 64-bit field code, and the SSE2 variant uses intrinsics; the GCC inline-asm ge25519_scalarmult_base_choose_niels is not compiled (it is behind COMPILER_GCC), so cl gets the C version. No upstream file is patched. Exports come from scripts/corpus/exercisers/ed25519_donna.def, because the source declares none. ed25519_randombytes_unsafe is the stub from scripts/corpus/exercisers and must never run. Measured against the MinGW artefacts: no PicHash of ten instructions or more is shared on either architecture; against data/cryptopp 8.9.0 MSVC, 12 of 75 (x86) and 10 of 73 (x64). Built against the DLL runtime, so the MSVC C runtime is imported and stays attributed to data/MSVC.
